So we can call it twice: once for 4567 with formatted true, once for 4567 with formatted false, same for 7890. Or we can call it twice per number? Actually we need both formatted string and array for each number. So we need 4 calls: 4567 formatted true, 4567 formatted false, 7890 formatted true, 7890 formatted false.

We should use the tool. The user wants both forms. So we will call the function for each number and each format. Then we will output the results.
